capture_source: live captures 2026-11-27, ABAP Platform 2025 (kernel 916), Unicode: ABAP sending tRFC (CALL FUNCTION ... IN BACKGROUND TASK DESTINATION) and qRFC (TRFC_SET_QUEUE_NAME first) LUWs through a registered destination to a registered server: first a server built on the NW RFC SDK 7.50 with its transaction handlers installed, then saprfclib's RfcServer.
sanitised: length-preserving, in ASCII and UTF-16LE and as raw IPv4 bytes: server address -> 198.51.100.9 (also as the eight hex digits that start every TID), client address -> 198.51.100.7, client host -> 'host1', operating-system user -> 'osuser000001'.
evidence: tier 1 live capture; the ABAP-side outcomes noted per case are tier 3 probes
frames: the bytes after the 80-byte gateway header, one call or answer each; a frame that keeps the conversation open (0x06CB) ends in the 8-byte invoke footer after the terminator

one_call.note: STFC_CONNECTION; ran, committed, confirmed in the same conversation

three_calls.note: STFC_CONNECTION, Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP2 (deep structure, string table), STFC_CONNECTION
